tokens.name: color-accent-teal
tokens.usage: On-dark accent only: performance stat numbers on `color-surface-inverse`. Never on white. Contrast 8.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: color-action-default
tokens.usage: The engine’s primary seed itself (--ig-primary-seed), not a fitted shade. Every action: primary CTA fill (label `color-action-on`), in-page links and eyebrows on `color-surface-page` and `color-surface-tint`. Contrast 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`.

tokens.name: color-action-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover on light surfaces (colour shift only, no underline). Contrast 5.4:1 on `color-surface-page`.

tokens.name: color-action-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Filled-button hover: the primary fill darkens to this and nothing else changes.

tokens.name: color-action-active
tokens.usage: Inline link press state on light surfaces. Contrast 8.8:1 on `color-surface-page`.

gradient.note: Gradients and ambient glows. Three uses only: clipped headline text, the hero wash and glows, and the footer.

tokens.name: footer-background-gradient
tokens.usage: The site footer’s own 155° gradient — one of the two dark surfaces in the system.

tokens.name: gradient-brand
tokens.usage: The 92° blue→violet, clipped to one headline fragment per section. Never a background fill, button or tile.

tokens.name: gradient-hero
tokens.usage: The hero wash behind the homepage hero.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Ambient radial glow behind hero and section content, bleeding off the edges, `pointer-events:none`.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Ambient radial glow partnered with `glow-blue` on light sections.

tokens.name: glow-violet-strong
tokens.usage: Footer glow only (top-right of the dark footer).

tokens.name: glow-pink
tokens.usage: Ambient glow for the dark AI and enterprise bands only.

tokens.name: glow-teal
tokens.usage: Ambient glow for the dark AI and enterprise bands and the footer.

breakpoint.note: The layout only changes at these four; the container is fluid between them.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: Two-up copy/media splits stack; footer collapses to accordions; catalog drops to one column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Nav collapses to a menu button; the utility bar hides.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: Feature grid goes 3-up → 2-up; the nav items collapse to a menu.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xl
tokens.usage: Container reaches full width; the gutter stops growing; secondary nav links hide below it.
